title: USDT/USDC same-underlying perpetual convergence using settlement mark prices

provenance.reason_for_new_id: HY-EXP-0007 failed before PnL because all June 2026 mark-price archives omit one complete UTC day
provenance.data_rule_change: replace continuous mark-price klines and monthly funding archives with the official funding history response, which supplies realized fundingRate and settlement markPrice together

inputs: USDT and USDC perpetual contract klines
official funding history snapshots containing realized fundingRate and settlement markPrice for both legs
data.funding_snapshot_rule: after preregistration, paginate each symbol from its declared start through the evaluation boundary with limit 1000; save and hash the complete JSON response before PnL
data.quality_policy: fail before PnL on corrupt ZIP, invalid funding JSON, missing or non-positive settlement markPrice, funding timestamp lag of at least one second, hash mismatch, duplicate normalized timestamp, non-contiguous required contract/FX 5m series, missing archive inside a declared coverage window, or missing signal/entry/exit/funding FX valuation data

signal.spread: log(USDT perpetual contract close / (USDC perpetual contract close * USDCUSDT spot close))
signal.decision_time: close of a synchronized completed 5m contract and FX bar
signal.robust_statistics_update: at 00:00 UTC only, using exactly the prior 8640 synchronized spreads and excluding every bar from the current UTC day
signal.center: median of the frozen prior window
signal.scale: 1.4826 times median absolute deviation from the frozen center
signal.direction: positive deviation: short USDT and long USDC; negative deviation: long USDT and short USDC
signal.entry_time: both legs at the next synchronized 5m contract open
signal.base_quantity: equal base-asset quantity on both legs; quantity makes converted entry notionals sum to the reference gross notional
signal.rearm: after an event, require absolute deviation below 0.003 and absolute robust z below 2 before another event in that base asset
signal.exit: after entry, use the entry event's frozen center; when signed spread deviation is non-positive on a completed 5m bar, exit both legs at the next synchronized open
signal.maximum_hold: 24 hours from the nominal simultaneous entry
signal.overlap: at most one open event per base asset; different base assets may overlap

liquidity.eligibility_time: all volume and participation checks use bars strictly before the signal bar
liquidity.rejection: if either leg fails either liquidity check, no event is created

execution.fees: charge both legs on entry and exit simulated fill notionals in their settlement asset
execution.funding: charge every official realized event with entry_time_for_leg <= fundingTime < exit_time using the markPrice returned in that same funding history row; convert USDC cash flows at USDCUSDT spot open at the normalized funding timestamp
execution.fx_conversion: convert USDC entry notional, exit PnL, fees and funding to USDT with synchronized USDCUSDT spot prices at their event times
execution.base_and_stress_fill: both legs fill at the same next 5m open
execution.extreme_leg_risk: evaluate USDT-first and USDC-first; the delayed leg fills one full 5m bar later, and retain the worse net result for that event
execution.rejected_or_partial_live_order: not modeled as a successful pair; PAPER_ONLY remains mandatory and no live order is authorized

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a new point-in-time universe replication with order-book and simultaneous-fill shadow evidence
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any spread threshold, robust z, liquidity gate, rearm rule or exit change requires a new experiment id
interpretation.prohibited_claim: independent out-of-sample profitability or live-trading value
interpretation.known_bias: the eight-base diagnostic panel is fixed after archive coverage inspection and is not a historical full-market universe
interpretation.structural_caveat: 5m contract opens plus slippage cannot prove two-leg simultaneity; the extreme scenario is a deterministic latency stress, not an order-book replay
interpretation.special_caveat: the replacement funding source was selected after observing archive structure but before any H4 spread or PnL
